description: This file contains utility functions for handling vector stores and retrievers in a machine learning or AI context, including resolving vector store or retriever configurations, adding MMR input parameters, and providing instructions for file upload handling.

methods.name: resolveVectorStoreOrRetriever
methods.description: Configures and returns a vector store or retriever based on node data inputs, supporting different search types like 'mmr' and 'similarity'.

methods.name: addMMRInputParams
methods.description: Adds specific input parameters related to Max Marginal Relevance (MMR) search to an input array.

methods.name: howToUseFileUpload
methods.description: Provides instructions and notes on how to use the file upload feature with the vector store.
